errors.evidence: The blue segment represents the increase, but it is stacked on top of the green segment (2021 expenditures), not starting at the zero-based axis first. The green segment is the base.
The description omits the exact positioning of the black reference line (1.5% above the 2021 value) relative to the green segment for most countries, which is a key visual feature.
The description does not explicitly mention that the countries are sorted by total bar length (descending), though it implies this with 'absteigender Reihenfolge ihrer optischen Gesamtlänge'.
The description omits the tick interval of 0.5 on the x-axis, though it mentions 'gleichmäßigen Intervallen von 1', which is incorrect.
